Hints: Since it passes through the origin, the y-intercept is 0;The equation is simply $y = mx$

Hints: Parallel lines have the exact same slope;Look for the equation with a slope of 4
Solution: Parallel lines have the same slope. The given line has m = 4. The only option with m = 4 is y = 4x + 5.

Fill: A plant is 3cm tall and grows 2cm per week. Write the linear model: $y = \_\_ x + 3$

Solution: The initial value is the intercept (3). The rate of change is the slope (2). So the equation is y = 2x + 3.
